title: Dwarf tomato stress imaging and phenotypic measurements
publisher: Zenodo; originating researchers: Del Cioppo, Giorgia (University of Helsinki); Poque, Sylvain (University of Helsinki); Scalabrino, Simone (University of Molise); SCIPPA, GABRIELLA (University of Molise); Himanen, Kristiina (University of Helsinki); Trupiano, Dalila (University of Molise)
deterministic_selection_rule: Complete source-defined Tiny Tim NPQ imaging archive and both full original metadata/phenotype workbooks; other cultivar NPQ and both large RGB archives excluded. Workbooks retain all cultivars; images cover only Tiny Tim.

substitution.reason: Dryad public individual-download endpoints returned HTTP 403; API payload endpoints required authorization; public browser navigation timed out. No successful payload transfer. Approved reserve used.
substitution.additional_note: Author GitHub repository was inspected, but does not offer the complete displayed Dryad raw archive; partial replication was not admitted as the planned complete bundle.

measurement_dates.description: Metadata.xlsx spans 2023-11-27 to 2024-06-17 08:47:49; 347 records from 81 plant IDs. Released 2026-06-11.
measurement_dates.status: documented where explicit; otherwise unknown, never inferred from release

author_preprocessing: NPQ pixel products and an integrated source-derived phenotypic table; RGB images and Micro-Tom NPQ images are omitted under the size limit. Supplied morphology/indices are already extracted, not instrument voltages.
known_analyses_and_limitations: The data accompany Image-based biomarkers effectively predict salt and drought stress in dwarf tomatoes. Metadata and main workbook use potentially inconsistent DAS/DAG definitions/order; retain both and reconcile from protocol before analysis. One cultivar has included images; metadata for the other is not missing imagery to invent.
